verdict.rationale: USCIS documents a Case Status API and a FOIA API with developer keys and a sandbox, which a developer could use to build their own polling automation. These are developer building blocks, not a product-provided capability to configure autonomous background automations. The evidence shows no scheduled jobs, recurring triggers, or background workflows offered by USCIS itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
